description: For a user who HAS a list of business locations and wants to sell it on LocationLists. Nothing is stored and nothing is charged. Give what the list is (one sentence), about how many rows, and the figure they have in mind in US dollars: the result says whether it holds up against what lists that size sell for here and the closest lists already on the site, what the seller would keep (80%), and what we would list it at (list prices end in 9). Then sell_list hands the file over. The same check in a browser: https://locationlists.com/sell.

rows.description: About how many rows (locations) the list has

target_usd.description: The price the user has in mind for the whole file, US dollars

what.description: What the list is, in the user's words: 'Florida marinas with slip counts, from marina websites and county records'

name: price_my_list
title: Price a list the user wants to sell
